title: Olive's Rainy-Day Box
checkpoint: Reception Spring 2, week 3 — Learning — Phase 3: new sounds ow, oi, ear

pages.illustration: Olive the grey owl standing at the edge of a garden hedge.

pages.text: Olive looks for bits for a box.
pages.illustration: Olive the owl peering into the hedge, a small wooden box held in one claw.
Olive the owl picking up a small round coin from among the hedge leaves.
Olive the owl picking up a small curled snail shell shaped like a horn from the hedge.
Olive the owl picking up a second, pale shell from under the hedge.
Dark clouds gathering above the hedge, the first drops just starting to fall.

pages.text: Olive digs down. Olive pops the box down.
pages.illustration: Olive the owl setting the wooden box down safely in a dry gap under the hedge.

pages.text: Now Olive has lots in the box. Olive is set for rain. Olive had fun.
pages.illustration: Olive the owl sitting contentedly under the hedge beside the full wooden box, rain falling outside.
